title: Reproducing face bioelectric patterns via ion-channel misexpression induces ectopic eyes

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Reproducing face bioelectric patterns via ion-channel misexpression induces ectopic eyes

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The vertebrate face is patterned by bioelectric gradients that regionalize gene expression, and reproducing these voltage patterns elsewhere in a tadpole by misexpressing specific ion channels induces whole ectopic organs such as eyes on the gut or tail, regions not otherwise competent to make eyes in response to Pax6.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology › Bioelectric control: a mechanism for scaling cell behaviors to large-scale morphogenetic goals

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: Reproducing these patterns elsewhere in the body via misexpression of specific ion channels enables the induction of whole ectopic organs, such as eyes [152] on the gut or tail of a tadpole (thus unlocking novel capabilities of body regions, since only the anterior neurectoderm is competent to make eyes via signals from the chemical master regulator Pax6).

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology”, Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS (2023), doi:10.1007/s00018-023-04790-z; section “Bioelectric control: a mechanism for scaling cell behaviors to large-scale morphogenetic goals”. Scope: Xenopus laevis embryos and tadpoles

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-agential-07: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.67

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The intervention, anatomical outcome, and controls are concrete. Public literature and molecular repositories can test pieces, but a full causal test needs matched animal-level voltage, expression, and morphology data.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Analyze voltage maps, ion-channel constructs, ectopic-eye incidence and location, and regional gene-expression responses in treated and control tadpoles. Voltage-matched manipulations using distinct channels should induce eyes outside Pax6-competent anterior tissue, whereas voltage-failing controls should not.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Ion-channel misexpression has effects beyond voltage.

Raw voltage and morphology data may not be jointly deposited.

Eye identity and functional completeness require multiple readouts.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.92
analysis feasibility: 0.75
data adequacy: 0.48
discriminating power: 0.72
data existence: 0.55

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Eye presence, injection site, and the Pax6 contrast are standard experimental variables, and the published Xenopus literature, indexed for this species in Xenbase, reports them. There is no open matrix of voltage pattern against organ outcome that an outside group can reprocess, and independent replication series are not a separate dataset. The test is therefore a reassessment of published measurements for this species, not a full reanalysis.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: In Xenopus tadpoles, compare eye formation after misexpression of the specified ion channels that reproduce a facial voltage pattern in gut or tail, against the same sites after Pax6 delivery alone. Ectopic eyes at those sites after the voltage manipulation, and not after Pax6 there, would support the report; no ectopic eyes, or eyes induced equally by Pax6 outside the anterior neurectoderm, would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The induction frequencies and voltage images are in the original papers' figures, not a public animal-level file.

Injected cells can recruit neighbours, so the competent tissue is not cleanly the injected territory alone.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.5
analysis feasibility: 0.5
discriminating power: 0.55
data existence: 0.45
operationalizability: 0.8
